parts.zh: 一位81岁的老人在试图从英国纽卡斯尔前往意大利罗马时意外到达了德国
这位领取养老金的老人此行是为了拜见天主教会领袖教皇
当GPS系统告诉他已经到达目的地时
老人停好车,但没有正确拉上手刹
他的车向后滑行,极具讽刺意味的是
警方表示,汽车撞上标志牌后停了下来
这位生活在英国、原籍意大利的老人可能是因为罗马在意大利语中写作"Roma"
M: 哦,不。那肯定要你自己决定

items.stem: What did the old age pensioner plan to do?

choices.text: See the Pope.
choices.zh: 见教皇。

choices.text: Go to Newcastle.
choices.zh: 去纽卡斯尔。

choices.text: Travel to Germany.
choices.zh: 去德国旅行。

choices.text: Tour an Italian city.
choices.zh: 游览一座意大利城市。

items.stem: What finally happened to the old man?

choices.text: He was taken to hospital in an ambulance.
choices.zh: 他被救护车送往医院。

choices.text: His car hit a sign and was badly damaged.
choices.zh: 他的车撞到了标志牌,严重损坏。

choices.text: His GPS system went out of order.
choices.zh: 他的GPS系统出现故障。

choices.text: He ended up in the wrong place.
choices.zh: 他最终到了错误的地方。

items.stem: What do we learn from the news report?

choices.text: Scotland will reach the national target in carbon emissions reduction ahead of schedule.
choices.zh: 苏格兰将提前完成碳排放减排的国家目标。

choices.text: Glasgow City Council has made a deal with ScottishPower on carbon emissions.
choices.zh: Glasgow市议会已与ScottishPower就碳排放达成协议。

choices.text: Glasgow has pledged to take the lead in reducing carbon emissions in the UK.
choices.zh: Glasgow承诺在英国率先减少碳排放。

choices.text: First Minister Nicola Sturgeon urged ScottishPower to reduce carbon emissions.
choices.zh: 首席大臣Nicola Sturgeon敦促ScottishPower减少碳排放。

items.stem: What did ScottishPower's chief executive say ahead of the All Energy Conference?

choices.text: Glasgow needs to invest in new technologies to reach its goal.
choices.zh: Glasgow需要投资新技术才能实现其目标。

choices.text: Glasgow is going to explore new sources of renewable energy.
choices.zh: Glasgow将探索可再生能源的新来源。

choices.text: Stricter regulation is needed in transforming Glasgow's economy.
choices.zh: 在转变Glasgow经济方面需要更严格的监管。

choices.text: It's necessary to create more low-emission zones as soon as possible.
choices.zh: 有必要尽快建立更多低排放区。

items.stem: What do we learn from the news report about the Japanese IT firm?

choices.text: It donates money to overpopulated animal shelters.
choices.zh: 它向动物数量过多的收容所捐款。

choices.text: It permits employees to bring cats into their office.
choices.zh: 它允许员工把猫带到办公室。

choices.text: It gives 5,000 yen to employees who keep pet cats.
choices.zh: 它给养宠物猫的员工发放5000日元。

choices.text: It allows workers to do whatever their hearts desire.
choices.zh: 它允许员工做任何他们心里想做的事。

items.stem: What does Fukuda encourage his employees to do?

choices.text: Keep cats off the street.
choices.zh: 让猫远离街道。

choices.text: Rescue homeless cats.
choices.zh: 救助流浪猫。

choices.text: Volunteer to help in animal shelters.
choices.zh: 自愿到动物收容所帮忙。

choices.text: Contribute to a fund for cat protection.
choices.zh: 向猫保护基金捐款。

items.stem: What does the news report say about the firm's policy?

choices.text: It has contributed tremendously to the firm's fame.
choices.zh: 它极大地提升了公司的知名度。

choices.text: It has helped a lot to improve animals' well-being.
choices.zh: 它对改善动物福祉帮助很大。

choices.text: It has led some other companies to follow suit.
choices.zh: 它促使其他一些公司效仿。

choices.text: It has resulted in damage to office equipment.
choices.zh: 它导致了办公设备的损坏。

items.stem: What does the man want to do?

choices.text: Find out where Jimmy is.
choices.zh: 找出Jimmy在哪里。

choices.text: Borrow money from Jimmy.
choices.zh: 向Jimmy借钱。

choices.text: Make friends with Jimmy.
choices.zh: 和Jimmy交朋友。

choices.text: Ask Jimmy what is to be done.
choices.zh: 问Jimmy该做什么。

items.stem: What do we learn about the man who came to see the woman yesterday?

choices.text: He was unsure what kind of fellow Jimmy was.
choices.zh: 他不确定Jimmy是什么样的人。

choices.text: He was working on a study project with Jimmy.
choices.zh: 他正在和Jimmy一起做一个研究项目。

choices.text: He wanted to make a sincere apology to Jimmy.
choices.zh: 他想向Jimmy真诚地道歉。

choices.text: He wanted to invite her to join in a study project.
choices.zh: 他想邀请她加入一个研究项目。

items.stem: What did Jimmy say happened to him one day?

choices.text: He got a ticket for speeding.
choices.zh: 他因超速而被开罚单。

choices.text: He got his car badly damaged.
choices.zh: 他的车严重损坏了。

choices.text: He was involved in a traffic accident.
choices.zh: 他卷入了一起交通事故。

choices.text: He had an operation for his injury.
choices.zh: 他因受伤做了手术。

items.stem: Why did Jimmy borrow money according to the man?

choices.text: He needed to make some donations to charity.
choices.zh: 他需要向慈善机构捐款。

choices.text: He found the 60 pounds in his pocket missing.
choices.zh: 他发现口袋里的60英镑不见了。

choices.text: He wanted to buy a gift for his mother's birthday.
choices.zh: 他想为母亲的生日买一份礼物。

choices.text: He wanted to conceal something from his parents.
choices.zh: 他想向父母隐瞒某事。

items.stem: What did the woman want to ask Max about?

choices.text: Shopping delivery.
choices.zh: 购物配送。

choices.text: Shopping online.
choices.zh: 网上购物。

choices.text: Where he goes shopping.
choices.zh: 他去哪里购物。

choices.text: How often he does shopping.
choices.zh: 他多久购物一次。

items.stem: What does the man think is a problem with shopping in supermarkets?

choices.text: Searching in the aisles.
choices.zh: 在过道里寻找商品。

choices.text: Dealing with the traffic.
choices.zh: 应对交通状况。

choices.text: Driving too long a distance.
choices.zh: 开车距离太远。

choices.text: Getting one's car parked.
choices.zh: 停车。

items.stem: What is the woman's concern about shopping online?

choices.text: The after-sales service.
choices.zh: 售后服务。

choices.text: The replacement policy.
choices.zh: 退换政策。

choices.text: The quality of food products.
choices.zh: 食品的质量。

choices.text: The damage to the packaging.
choices.zh: 包装的损坏。

items.stem: What does the man find about shopping online?

choices.text: It saves money.
choices.zh: 省钱。

choices.text: It offers more choice.
choices.zh: 提供更多选择。

choices.text: It increases the joy of shopping.
choices.zh: 增加购物的乐趣。

choices.text: It is less time-consuming.
choices.zh: 更省时间。

items.stem: What did a recent study find about some British children?

choices.text: They have little talent for learning math.
choices.zh: 他们学习数学的天赋很少。

choices.text: They need medical help for math anxiety.
choices.zh: 他们需要医疗帮助来应对数学焦虑。

choices.text: They need extra help to catch up in the math class.
choices.zh: 他们需要额外帮助才能在数学课上赶上进度。

choices.text: They have strong negative emotions towards math.
choices.zh: 他们对数学有强烈的负面情绪。

items.stem: What is the widespread misunderstanding about math anxiety?

choices.text: It will gradually pass away without teachers' help.
choices.zh: 它会在没有教师帮助的情况下逐渐消失。

choices.text: It affects low performing children only.
choices.zh: 它只影响成绩差的儿童。

choices.text: It is related to a child's low intelligence.
choices.zh: 它与儿童的低智商有关。

choices.text: It exists mostly among children from poor families.
choices.zh: 它主要存在于来自贫困家庭的儿童中。

items.stem: What does the passage say about British students with math anxiety?

choices.text: Most of them have average to strong math ability.
choices.zh: 他们中的大多数具有中等到较强的数学能力。

choices.text: Most of them get timely help from their teachers.
choices.zh: 他们中的大多数从老师那里得到及时的帮助。

choices.text: They will regain confidence with counselling.
choices.zh: 他们通过咨询会重新获得信心。

choices.text: They are mostly secondary school students.
choices.zh: 他们大多数是中学生。

items.stem: What conclusion has the World Health Organization come to recently?

choices.text: Social media addiction is a threat to our health.
choices.zh: 社交媒体成瘾是对我们健康的威胁。

choices.text: Too many people are addicted to smartphones.
choices.zh: 太多人对智能手机上瘾。

choices.text: Addiction to computer games is a disease.
choices.zh: 电脑游戏成瘾是一种疾病。

choices.text: Computer games can be rather addictive.
choices.zh: 电脑游戏可能相当容易让人上瘾。

items.stem: What is said of people with addictive behavior?

choices.text: They prioritize their favored activity over what they should do.
choices.zh: 他们把自己喜欢的活动置于应该做的事情之上。

choices.text: They do their favored activity whenever and wherever possible.
choices.zh: 他们随时随地尽可能从事自己喜欢的活动。

choices.text: They are unaware of the damage their behavior is doing to them.
choices.zh: 他们没有意识到自己的行为对他们造成的伤害。

choices.text: They are unable to get rid of their addiction without professional help.
choices.zh: 他们无法在没有专业帮助的情况下摆脱成瘾。

items.stem: What do some behavior experts think of addiction to computer games?

choices.text: It may be less damaging than previously believed.
choices.zh: 它的危害可能比之前认为的要小。

choices.text: There will never be agreement on its harm to people.
choices.zh: 人们永远不会就其危害达成一致。

choices.text: It may prove to be beneficial to developing creativity.
choices.zh: 它可能被证明有益于培养创造力。

choices.text: There is not enough evidence to classify it as a disease.
choices.zh: 没有足够的证据将其归类为一种疾病。

items.stem: What do we learn about most European passports?

choices.text: They are relatively uniform in color and design.
choices.zh: 它们在颜色和设计上相对统一。

choices.text: They appear more formal than other passports.
choices.zh: 它们看起来比其他护照更正式。

choices.text: They are a shade of red bordering on brown.
choices.zh: 它们是一种近乎棕色的红色。

choices.text: They vary in color from country to country.
choices.zh: 它们的颜色因国家而异。

items.stem: What does the passage say about the design of passports?

choices.text: They must endure wear and tear.
choices.zh: 它们必须经得起磨损。

choices.text: They must be of the same size.
choices.zh: 它们必须尺寸相同。

choices.text: They must be made from a rare material.
choices.zh: 它们必须由稀有材料制成。

choices.text: They must follow some common standards.
choices.zh: 它们必须遵循一些共同标准。

items.stem: Why are dark colors chosen for passport covers?

choices.text: They look more traditional.
choices.zh: 它们看起来更传统。

choices.text: They look more official.
choices.zh: 它们看起来更正式。

choices.text: They are favored by airlines.
choices.zh: 它们受到航空公司的青睐。

choices.text: They are easily identifiable.
choices.zh: 它们容易识别。

items.stem: What is one special function of the images inside many passports?

choices.text: For beauty.
choices.zh: 为了美观。

choices.text: For variety.
choices.zh: 为了多样性。

choices.text: For visibility.
choices.zh: 为了可见性。

choices.text: For security.
choices.zh: 为了安全性。
